newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers heavy after share offering.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers heavy after share offering.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc was one of the most heavily traded stocks on the New York Stock Exchange in early trading Wednesday after a share offering of 6,780,135 Class A shares.
More than 1.1 million shares had traded, with the stock off 1/8 to 19-1/4. The shares priced at $19.25 each late on Tuesday, according to lead underwriter Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette.
The company raised the number of shares to be sold by selling shareholders to 780,135 from an initial estimate of 339,836 shares.
Six million shares were sold by the Panthers, which is controlled by Wayne Huizenga. The company owns the Florida Panthers hockey team and several Florida hotels and resorts.
